releases.notes:
**New Features**

- Forest type mapping mode
- Tree species mapping mode, shows the dominate tree species as well as possible trees. Works with AFC and should work with any other trees added by other addons
- Soil mapping mode, shows what soil the region contains

**Improvements**

- Fixed 2 cases of crashing when switching between map modes
- Greatly improved performance for all TFC map modes, in some case 10x faster

releases.notes:
# World Preview TFC 2.0.0

## Added
- Seed Search tab in the Create World screen
- Seed search UI: search area button, max-seeds input, biome match mode toggle (ANY/ALL), TFC settings button, start/stop/skip/preview/copy actions, and status messaging.
- Seed search options: biome checkbox list, terrain feature list
- Added Hotspot Mapping mode
- Added volcano icons to map
- Biome Search in preview screen with island filter
- Water/Land map now shows rivers

## Changed
- Changed namespace for assets and data
- Added custom button textures
- Changed package names
- Added World Preview Neoforged as incompatible mod
- Mods TFC settings and TFC World gen settings page now sync
- Made World gen settings on in game preview read only (they were before but its more clear now)
- Lots of performance improvements, it can still be slow especially with height sampling enabled and max map size
- Removed unused features like y level sampling (might regret that if TFC ever adds underground biomes)
- Fixed lots of bugs.

releases.notes:
**New Features**

- Added button to change map scale
- Removed unused buttons from UI
- Cleaned up UI, TFC mapping modes are all hidden by the expaned button
- Add abaility to search for biomes by selecting them from the list and hitting search. Max search radius is 50,000 blocks in 2,000 block steps. Note that rare biomes can take a long time to find.
- Perforamce improvments for the TFC map modes
- Added rock list with highlighting similar to biomes
- Display possible spawn area on map
- When using preview in game now centers map on player instead of 0,0
- Added a Kaolin clay map mode that will display areas where Kaolin clay can spawn. (Correct temp, rain and biome)
- Added support for neofroge versions 21.1.213+


**Bug Fixes**

- Fixed crash when switching levels and on a TFC map mode
- Fixed other minor bugs and issues
